heading: INT. RELAY STATION KESTREL - ORBITAL CORRIDOR - NIGHT CYCLE

units.text: INT. RELAY STATION KESTREL - ORBITAL CORRIDOR - NIGHT CYCLE
A narrow tube lined with cable trays and amber emergency strips.
Frost on the viewport.
Beyond it, the planet turns, enormous, blue-grey, indifferent.
MIREILLE OSEI-TANAKA, thirties, in a thermal coverall, floats in the corridor with a handheld recorder clamped in her teeth.
She pulls herself along a rail, one-handed, a tablet strapped to her forearm.
The tablet blinks red: LIFE SUPPORT RESERVE 14 PERCENT.
She stops.
Takes the recorder from her mouth.
Log. Day sixty-one. Oxygen is the problem now. Not the comms, not the hull. Oxygen.
units.name: MIREILLE

units.text: She presses a key on the tablet.
A recorded voice plays through the speaker, her own, crisp and unhurried.
Day nine. Everything nominal. I've started a plant. I'm calling it Gerald.
units.name: MIREILLE

units.text: Mireille almost smiles.
She pushes off toward the end of the corridor, drifting past a row of sealed hatches.
Day twenty-two. Still nominal. Gerald is dying. I think I overwatered him.
units.name: MIREILLE

units.text: A hatch light flickers.
She grabs the frame, braces, and keys a code.
The hatch opens on a dark hydroponics bay, lit only by one withered stalk in a clear tube.
Hello, old friend.
units.name: MIREILLE

units.text: The tablet chirps.
Another recording plays, closer, rougher.
Day fifty. If anyone is hearing this, I have sixteen days of air and a very sick shrub. Please send a ship. Please send a ship that knows how to fix a shrub.
units.name: MIREILLE

units.text: She floats to the tube.
Touches the glass.
Sixty-one.
units.name: MIREILLE

units.text: She twists a valve.
A pale mist hisses into the tube.
The stalk shivers, and a single bud, no bigger than a grain of rice, opens.
Mireille stares at it.
Then at the tablet.
Then back at the bud, and without a word she begins pulling cables free from the wall panel, humming under her breath, working faster.
Day sixty-one. Gerald lives.
units.name: MIREILLE
